title: More on modal logics and deduction
summary: We study the relation between additivity and deduction theorems in the algebraic semantics of congruential modal logic. Additivity of the modal operator is well-known to imply the local deduction-detachment theorem. Our main theme is that deduction properties of modal logic persist far beyond the additive setting.
